standard_prerequisites.name: The pullback of modules along the structure morphism to the point with the given ring, and its description as a sheafification of a tensor product presheaf
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 1402-1405) as a cross-chapter pointer
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the first and the third construction.

standard_prerequisites.name: The right exactness of the pullback and its compatibility with direct sums
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 1406-1411) as a pointer to a lemma of this chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Transports a presentation of the module to a presentation of the pulled back sheaf, which identifies the second construction with the first.

core_obligations: First equals third: the pullback is by definition the sheafification of the tensor product presheaf, so the first and third constructions agree (proof lines 1402-1405)

Second equals first: since the pullback is right exact, commutes with direct sums and sends the base ring to the structure sheaf, applying it to a presentation of the module produces exactly the cokernel description of the second construction (proof lines 1406-1411)
Quasi-coherence and functoriality: the first assertion is clear from the cokernel construction, and the second because the pullback has those properties (proof lines 1413-1415)
Stalks and adjunction: the description of the stalks of a pullback gives the third assertion, and adjointness of the direct image and the pullback gives the fourth (proof lines 1416-1419)
proof_roadmap: (1)=(3)：π^* 按定义就是预层 U ↦ O_X(U) ⊗_R M 的层化（跨章）。(2)=(1)：π^* 右正合、与任意直和交换且 π^*(R) = O_X（本章引理），故对 M 的展示作用 π^* 即得 (2) 的余核描述。
四个性质：(1) 由余核构造立得；(2) 因 π^* 有该性质；(3) 由 pullback 的茎描述（跨章）；(4) 由 π_* 与 π^* 的伴随。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives three constructions of the quasi-coherent sheaf associated to a module over the ring of global sections, proves them canonically isomorphic and records four properties including quasi-coherence, commutation with colimits and the adjunction formula (author lemma at source lines 1346-1399, label lemma-construct-quasi-coherent-sheaves). The proof (source lines 1401-1421) identifies the sheafification construction with the pullback, obtains the cokernel construction from the right exactness and the compatibility with direct sums of the pullback, and then reads the four properties off the corresponding properties of the pullback and the adjunction (proof lines 1406-1419). The comparison of the three constructions is the content. H2.
